lines.2: 「An amusement park. Or, put simply, an arcade.」
lines.3: 「I never come to places like this. Sometimes I stop by to take pictures when my friends ask, though.」
lines.5: Electronic sounds rang out all around us.
lines.9: 「It's a quiz game. We compete against other players online. It's a lot of fun.」
lines.10: 「Oh, they have games like that too?」
lines.11: 「I thought places like this were all about rattling joysticks around.」
lines.12: 「They've got all kinds of games these days.」
lines.16: A question appeared on the screen. Four choices.
lines.17: "Which of these was not done as part of the Kyoho Reforms?"
lines.18: 1. Official recognition of merchant guilds  2. Enactment of the Upper Kujikata Osadamegaki
lines.19: 3. Establishment of the petition box  4. Issuing the Agechi Order
lines.22: 「Make up your mind already. It's obviously four.」
lines.24: 「You should know at least this much!」
lines.25: The next question was about entertainment.
lines.31: 「Then I'll handle academics and general knowledge!」
lines.32: 「What's this? Another couple at the arcade? You see more and more of those lately... Man, I'm jealous.」
lines.33: 「Damn. If they were playing a fighting game, I'd jump in and beat the guy to a pulp! Guys with girls are usually terrible at games. Heh heh heh.」
lines.38: 「Ugh. Just looking at them is getting on my nerves. I'll go prove how hardcore I am by racking up wins at a fighting game.」
lines.40: 「What, no one's jumping in? I'm already at the final boss. This is boring.」
lines.43: 「Ngh... What's with this player!? They're countering my cheap tricks!」
lines.48: 「N-no way... I just helped him look good! Nooooo!」
lines.50: I thought I heard Fukahire's voice just now, but I must've imagined it.
